facts.text: Trails are unpaved, range from moderate to difficult, and are open to foot traffic only.
quote: Trails are unpaved and range from moderate to difficult.
Trails are open to foot traffic only

facts.text: The county’s visit page requires reservations 48 hours ahead because parking is limited, with one vehicle per reservation.
quote: Due to limited parking, reservations are required before you visit.
Each reservation is for one vehicle Reservations must be made 48 hours in advance

facts.text: The county describes it as a destination for a quiet hike and a more rugged outdoor experience.
facts.quote: It’s a great destination for visitors looking for a quiet hike and a more rugged outdoor experience.

facts.text: The county lists reservation visits on Tuesdays, Thursdays and the second and fourth Saturdays of each month, in two blocks: 9 a.m.–1 p.m. or 2–6 p.m. Choose an available date through its Parks program calendar; this is not daily walk-in admission.
quote: Reservation Days: Tuesdays and Thursdays 2nd and 4th Saturdays of each month Available Time Blocks: Block 1: 9 am-1pm Block 2: 2 pm-6 pm
Visit our Park's program calendar and select the day you'd like to visit.

facts.text: The county lists spring/summer park hours of 8 a.m.–8:30 p.m. and fall/winter hours of 8 a.m.–6 p.m. Vehicles left after closing may be ticketed and towed. These general hours do not replace the required reservation blocks.
quote: Park hours change by the season: Spring/Summer: 8 am-8:30 pm Fall/Winter: 8 am-6 pm Important: Vehicles left in the park after closing may be ticketed and towed.
To protect the preserve and manage limited parking, you must have a reservation before entering Boone Cliffs State Nature Preserve.

facts.text: The state agency describes the Boone Cliffs route as 2.4 miles over uneven terrain and flags steep cliffs as a hazard. Its “moderate” rating is a publisher description, not a wheelchair-route assessment.
facts.quote: Access - 2.4 mile trail over uneven terrain, moderate Facilities - none Parking - five cars; one bus Hazards - steep cliffs

facts.text: For Boone Cliffs, the state page lists no facilities. It does not identify toilets, drinking water or a changing space for a visit.
facts.quote: Access - 2.4 mile trail over uneven terrain, moderate Facilities - none Parking - five cars; one bus Hazards - steep cliffs

facts.text: The state directions lead to a gravel parking area on Middle Creek Road, 1.5 miles after turning from KY 18. The state page lists space for five cars and one bus; this is not a reservation or a confirmed boarding or parking-to-trail route.
quote: From the junction of I-75 and KY 18 near Florence, follow KY 18 west for 10.8 miles, then left on Middle Creek Road for 1.5 miles to gravel parking area on left side of road.

facts.text: The state agency says to reserve 24 hours ahead and gives 859-334-2117 for help making a reservation. Confirm the requirement before traveling.
quote: Boone County Cliffs State Nature Preserve now requires reservations 24 hour in advance of your visit.
If you need assistance making a reservation, call 859-334-2117.

facts.text: The county asks visitors to use extra caution during hunting season because private land surrounds parts of the preserve. Its preserve rules prohibit hunting or trapping within the preserve.
quote: During hunting season: Please use extra caution, as private land surrounds parts of the preserve.
